dischi-01.exo: The seed of material realisation: a concrete opportunity, a gain, a solid base on which to build. It announces physical wellbeing, financial stability, projects taking shape.
dischi-01.psy: A healthy relationship with the body, money and the tangible world: the trust that spirit can inhabit matter without being imprisoned by it.
dischi-01.ini: The Ace in Kether: the root of Earth and the final He of the Tetragrammaton, the Daughter who will be raised to the Mother's throne. Matter is conceived as a vortex of energy in motion; the throne of the Ace is the celestial quadrant of Aries, Taurus and Gemini, governed by the Princess of Disks.
dischi-01.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals greed, materialism, attachment to possessions, laziness.
dischi-01.up: A concrete opportunity appears: root it with patience and care and it will bear fruit.
dischi-01.rev: An opportunity missed or badly handled; money worries, or too much attention on gain.
dischi-01.love: A bond with concrete foundations, oriented toward stability and building together.
dischi-01.work: A new job, an investment, the start of a solid business.
dischi-01.spirit: Recognising the holiness of matter: the body as a temple.
dischi-01.crowley: Crowley places his own personal seal on the Ace of Disks, with the number of the Beast and wings, inside a rotating disk: Earth not as inert weight but as a force in motion.

dischi-02.exo: Change, alternation, the ability to juggle different situations. It points to financial movements, relocations, decisions to be taken with elasticity.
dischi-02.psy: The awareness that stability is born from movement, not from immobility; the art of adapting without losing your centre.
dischi-02.ini: Earth in Chokmah, with Jupiter in Capricorn, his sign of fall, in the first decan: Jupiterian benevolence contracts into Saturnine discipline. Change is the law of matter, where every form passes into another in an unceasing rhythm.
dischi-02.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals instability, inconstancy, waste, an inability to choose.
dischi-02.up: Adapt lightly: the change under way is a dance, not a danger.
dischi-02.rev: Difficulty managing several fronts, financial instability, resistance to change.
dischi-02.love: A relationship in transformation, an alternation of moments; flexibility is needed.
dischi-02.work: Managing several projects, relocations, changes of role or of market.
dischi-02.spirit: The eternal flow of the Tao: form dancing in change.
dischi-02.crowley: In the Thoth deck a crowned serpent coils in a figure of eight around two disks bearing the symbol of the Tao: change as an eternal and harmonious rhythm.

dischi-03.exo: Work well done, building, competence, productive collaboration. It points to projects taking shape, professional recognition, solid works.
dischi-03.psy: The satisfaction of building with your own hands and with others; the patience that turns an idea into reality.
dischi-03.ini: Earth in Binah, the Mother who gives form, with Mars exalted in Capricorn in the second decan: Martial energy becomes constructive labour. Works are form establishing itself, the pyramid rising from its foundations.
dischi-03.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals mediocrity, work without soul, selfishness, delays.
dischi-03.up: Your work is taking shape: commit to it with care and collaborate with those who share the vision.
dischi-03.rev: Neglected work, difficult collaborations, projects blocked or badly built.
dischi-03.love: Building together: shared projects, home, family.
dischi-03.spirit: Work as a path of spiritual realisation.
dischi-03.crowley: In the Thoth deck a pyramid seen from above rests on three wheels representing Mercury, Sulphur and Salt, above the Great Sea of Binah: the construction rising from primordial form.

dischi-04.exo: Earthly power, stability, material security, control of resources. It points to a consolidated position, a protected estate, clear rules and recognised authority.
dischi-04.psy: The security that comes from order and boundaries; but also the fear of losing what you own, which can turn protection into closure.
dischi-04.ini: Earth in Chesed, Mercy that organises, with the Sun in Capricorn in the third decan: sunlight brightens and steadies Saturnine form. Power is the law that establishes and defends, an order that protects until it becomes a prison.
dischi-04.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals avarice, rigidity, fear of change, an obsessive need for control.
dischi-04.up: Your position is solid: defend it wisely, but do not shut yourself inside your securities.
dischi-04.rev: Excessive control, attachment, fear of losing; or a stability beginning to waver.
dischi-04.love: A stable, protective relationship; beware of possessiveness and defensive routine.
dischi-04.work: A consolidated position, financial security, administration of assets and rules.
dischi-04.spirit: Stability as a foundation from which to rise, not as an enclosure.
dischi-04.crowley: In the Thoth deck a square fortress with four corner towers, ringed by a moat, stands out against an orderly landscape: power as a structure that protects and isolates.

dischi-05.exo: Worries, financial or health difficulties, anxiety about the future. It points to a period of prolonged tension linked to material security, often more wearing than dramatic.
dischi-05.psy: The anxiety that arises when stability wavers: the mind circles concrete problems without finding peace, and the unease becomes a burden in itself.
dischi-05.ini: Earth in Geburah, Severity, with Mercury in Taurus in the first decan: Mercurial intelligence frets within the slowness of Taurus. Worry is the stability of Chesed shaken by Geburah, a tension which, given the inert nature of Earth, tends to last.
dischi-05.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals mistrust, a sense of poverty, blockage, giving up the search for solutions.
dischi-05.up: Face the worries one at a time, pragmatically and without catastrophising; ask for concrete help.
dischi-05.rev: The anxiety begins to ease and solutions come into view; or worries ignored that pile up.
dischi-05.love: Tensions linked to practical matters, home or money; a need for mutual support.
dischi-05.work: Financial difficulties, job instability, pressure; reviewing the budget helps.
dischi-05.spirit: Cultivating trust even when the ground under your feet seems to move.
dischi-05.crowley: In the Thoth deck five disks arranged in an inverted pentagram carry the symbols of the tattvas, the Indian elements, in a tangle of tense lines: matter restless, at friction with itself.

dischi-06.exo: Material success, prosperity, balance between giving and receiving. It points to a concrete result achieved, earnings, health restored, generosity.
dischi-06.psy: The serenity of someone who has found a healthy balance with money and the body; the ability to share without feeling impoverished.
dischi-06.ini: Earth in Tiphareth, the harmonious heart, with the Moon exalted in Taurus in the second decan: lunar fertility blooms in the richest earth. Success is matter harmonised by solar consciousness, but it is a temporary success, tied to the lunar cycle.
dischi-06.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals ostentation, fleeting success, calculated generosity or dependence on the help of others.
dischi-06.up: Your efforts bear fruit: enjoy the success and share it in balance.
dischi-06.rev: Unstable success, an imbalance in giving and receiving, financial dependence or ostentation.
dischi-06.love: A balanced relationship, reciprocity, shared wellbeing.
dischi-06.work: Promotions, earnings, professional successes; a favourable moment to invest with measure.
dischi-06.spirit: Matter as an expression of divine harmony.
dischi-06.crowley: In the Thoth deck six planetary disks form a hexagram around a central Sun with the Rose Cross: the planets in harmony around the heart of the Tree.

dischi-07.exo: Failure, work unrewarded, stagnation. It points to efforts that do not give the hoped-for fruit, investments gone badly, a forced pause in growth.
dischi-07.psy: The frustration of someone who has worked without seeing results; the discouragement that risks turning into inertia and resignation.
dischi-07.ini: Earth in Netzach, unstable Victory, with Saturn in Taurus in the third decan: Saturnine weight smothers Taurean fertility. Failure is matter that jams, the harvest that rots before it ripens.
dischi-07.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals laziness, resignation, financial loss, blockage.
dischi-07.up: Accept the pause and review your method: not everything is lost, but a new strategy is needed.
dischi-07.rev: Failure denied or persistent; or a first sign of recovery after a long wait.
dischi-07.love: A relationship at a standstill, little satisfaction, efforts not returned.
dischi-07.work: Blocked projects, fruitless investments, delayed payments.
dischi-07.spirit: Accepting failure as a teacher of humility and patience.
dischi-07.crowley: Crowley arranges seven disks of lead in the geomantic figure Rubeus, on withered vegetation: the weight of Saturn smothering growth.
